description.value: Papa Dave's Pizza is a neighbourhood institution in New Westminster that has been hand-tossing pizzas for over two decades, building a loyal following with signature sauce recipes and locally sourced toppings. Beyond pizza, the menu spans Indian curry dishes, biryani, chicken tandoori, and pasta, making it an unusually eclectic and filling stop. An all-you-can-eat buffet and indoor/outdoor seating round out the experience for cyclists looking to refuel after a long ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms Papa Dave's Pizza is an active restaurant with dine-in, takeout, and delivery. OSM phone (+1-604-522-4001) matches the website (+1 6045224001). The website lists the address as 820 20th Street, New Westminster, BC V3M 2X4, which OSM omits entirely; the website also names two locations (New Westminster and Fraser Hwy/Surrey), making the exact OSM node ambiguous. Vegetarian options are confirmed by both OSM (diet:vegetarian=yes) and website (Spaghetti Veggie Pasta, customizable orders); vegan is explicitly tagged no in OSM. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere.
concerns: OSM record has no address; website supplies '820 20th Street, New Westminster, BC V3M 2X4' — added from website.
OSM community field is 'Vancouver' but the business address and website consistently reference New Westminster.

Website lists two distinct locations (New Westminster and Fraser Hwy/Surrey); it is unclear which location this OSM node (n965755379) represents — a second OSM record may exist for the Fraser Hwy Surrey branch.
Catering contact email on the website is 'info@nonstoppizza.ca', a different domain from the main site, which may indicate a rebranded or affiliated operation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating pizza restaurant with an active website, confirmed phone, and current menus and offers. Useful calorie stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: No vegan options identified on website
